verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is the core interaction model across Claude. First-party docs cover several surfaces: prompting in natural language to generate Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files; describing an outcome in Cowork and getting finished work back; scheduling recurring tasks you describe once; building artifacts by describing what you need; and full spoken conversations via voice mode (beta). Agentic browser and computer use, plus connectors for Gmail, Calendar and Drive, extend those plain-language requests into real actions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands reliably drive these agentic features (all evidence is vendor docs; community comments touch only on chat quality).
